_note: Proposed v1 tool profile. The authoritative definitions live on the server (busymate-ai-src); CI compares this file with the live tools/list. Claude rule: every tool that modifies data is destructiveHint:true.

tools.name: list_tenants
tools.summary: Lists the Busymate workspaces the signed-in user belongs to.

tools.name: get_tenant
tools.summary: Reads one workspace's name, website and assistant status.

tools.name: get_tenant_inbox_counts
tools.summary: Counts open conversations and handoff requests in a workspace.

tools.name: list_tenant_conversations
tools.summary: Lists recent customer conversations in a workspace, paginated.

tools.name: get_tenant_conversation_transcript
tools.summary: Reads the messages of one customer conversation.

tools.name: list_tenant_interventions
tools.summary: Lists handoff requests where the assistant asked for a person.

tools.name: get_tenant_intervention
tools.summary: Reads one handoff request and its conversation context.

tools.name: reply_tenant_intervention
tools.summary: Sends a reply from the business to the customer in a handoff conversation.

tools.name: resolve_tenant_intervention
tools.summary: Marks a handoff request resolved and hands the conversation back to the assistant.

tools.name: add_tenant_intervention_note
tools.summary: Adds an internal note to a handoff request; customers never see it.

tools.name: list_tenant_knowledge_sources
tools.summary: Lists the knowledge sources the assistant answers from.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.summary: Searches the workspace knowledge and returns matching passages with their source.

tools.name: add_tenant_knowledge_source
tools.summary: Adds a public web page as a knowledge source; Busymate fetches and indexes it.

tools.name: list_email_threads
tools.summary: Lists customer email threads in the workspace inbox.

tools.name: search_email
tools.summary: Searches customer email threads by text, sender or subject.

tools.name: get_email_thread
tools.summary: Reads the messages of one email thread.

tools.name: reply_email
tools.summary: Sends an email reply to the customer on an existing thread.

tools.name: get_install_snippet
tools.summary: Returns the script snippet that installs the assistant on the business's website.
